blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Christopher Lawrence “Bong” Go on Wednesday urged the Philippine Sports Commission (PSC) to prioritize athletes’ welfare over facility renovations. “Perhaps you could prioritize our athletes by providing them with their full allowances, transportation expenses, food, training support and equipment, including shoes for those who do not have sponsors,” Go said during a Senate budget hearing. His statement came as PSC Chairman John Patrick “Pato” Gregorio presented renovated facilities as part of the agency’s accomplishments ahead of deliberations on its proposed 2027 budget.
